summary.text: Blayne Osborn is a Republican member of the Nevada State Assembly who was appointed to District 39 in November 2025 and is seeking election to a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Blayne Osborn assumed office representing Nevada State Assembly District 39 on November 6, 2025, succeeding Ken Gray.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and faces Democrat Erich Obermayr in the general election.
